name: validate_target

test_list.description: Reject IPv4 and IPv6 loopback, private, link-local, unspecified, multicast, and IPv4-mapped private destinations.
Reject cloud metadata IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
Reject non-HTTP(S) URLs and URLs containing user information.
Resolve the hostname, reject mixed public/private answer sets, and pin the validated set for the request.
A public response redirecting to a private or loopback destination is blocked.
An explicit local self-host exception applies only to the configured origin.
Reject URLs above the request target byte limit before resolving their host.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Untrusted destination URL supplied by a caller or redirect.

inputs.name: local_origin
inputs.description: Optional exact origin explicitly configured for a local self-hosted service.

output_description: A URL and its pinned, validated DNS address set, or a sanitized block reason.
